recipe.title: Pav Bhaji

ingredients.name: 1 tsp + ¼ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder / lal mirch powder
1 tsp + ½ tsp pav bhaji masala
1 tsp + 1 tsp kasuri methi / dry fenugreek leaves
2 tbsp + 1 tbsp coriander leaves (finely chop ped)
½ tsp kashmiri red chilli powder / lal mirch powder

steps.text: Firstly, in a large kadai heat 1 tbsp butter and add vegetables. cook and mash well.
steps.label: Cook vegetables

steps.text: Add 1 tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp pav bhaji masala, 1 tsp kasuri methi and 2 tbsp coriander leaves.
steps.label: Season bhaji

steps.text: heat a tbsp of butter and add ¼ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp pav bhaji masala, 1 tsp kasuri methi.
steps.label: Prepare tadka

steps.text: also add 1 tbsp coriander leaves, 1 tsp ginger garlic paste, 1 onion and ½ lemon juice. saute well.
steps.label: Saute aromatics

steps.text: now add 3 drops of red food colour and mix well.
steps.label: Add colour

steps.text: boil and mash for 5 minutes adjusting consistency.
steps.label: Boil and mash

steps.text: Finally, serve pav and bhaji as pav bhaji.
steps.label: Serve
